title: PulsHealth — daily data and coverage
description: Starter dashboard. Read README before use. Uses existing puls-tsdb datasource; no credentials included.

panels.title: Daily steps by provenance
panels.description: Daily values in the stack time zone; aggregate and fallback series stay distinct. Edge days are whole-day totals.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE puls_time_zone() AS time,
       value, source AS metric
FROM metric_daily
WHERE identifier = 'HKQuantityTypeIdentifierStepCount'
  AND user_id = ${user:sqlstring}::uuid
  AND day >= ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE puls_time_zone())::date
  AND day <= ($__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE puls_time_zone())::date
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Hours since latest received batch (90-day lookback)
panels.description: Ignores dashboard time selection. A recent receipt may contain old records. No value means no batch in 90 days.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - max(received_at))) / 3600 AS hours
FROM batches
WHERE user_id = ${user:sqlstring}::uuid
  AND received_at >= now() - interval '90 days'

panels.title: Recorded workout duration
panels.description: One point per workout; records, not proof of complete activity coverage.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT start_ts AS time, duration_s / 60.0 AS minutes
FROM workouts
WHERE user_id = ${user:sqlstring}::uuid
  AND $__timeFilter(start_ts)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Daily step provenance
panels.description: Whole local calendar days intersecting selected range; aggregate is preferred over rollup.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT day::text AS day, value AS steps, source
FROM metric_daily
WHERE identifier = 'HKQuantityTypeIdentifierStepCount'
  AND user_id = ${user:sqlstring}::uuid
  AND day >= ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE puls_time_zone())::date
  AND day <= ($__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE puls_time_zone())::date
ORDER BY day DESC
